svg.text: 12c Product form: edit (use a recipe), with a field error
Route: /admin/products (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• “Use a recipe” replaces Stock qty / Minimum level with the recipe rows (raw material, amount per serving, unit, remove). Each raw material can be used once per recipe.
• Checks on Save, each shown under its field and focusing the first problem: name required; price ₱0.00 or more; cost blank or ₱0.00 or more; prep time whole minutes 0–120; stock and
minimum whole numbers; a recipe needs at least one complete row. A barcode already in use comes back from the API (409) under Barcode.
• A recipe dish also has “Add the recipe's raw materials as ingredients” and “Calculate from recipe” (POST /api/nutrition/estimate): each raw material's grams per serving ÷ 100 × its
values per 100 g (set in 14d), added up. Raw materials without nutrition, or pieces without a weight, are left out and named; ml without a weight counts as 1 g per ml.

g.text: Scan with a barcode reader, or type manually
Optional. Without a photo, the kiosk shows the icon. JPEG, PNG
or WebP; it's made smaller before uploading.
For one serving. Use 0 for items served as they are, like bottled drinks.
Orders use it to estimate when they'll be ready.
Raw materials used by one serving. Paying for an order deducts these,
and the dish shows as sold out when they can't make another serving.
Per serving: Raw material 150 g, Raw material 1 pc
Add the recipe's raw materials as ingredients
The kiosk shows these as estimated values. Leave a value blank if it isn't known.
